ocr.markdown:
Here's what's cookin': Party Cheese Ball
Recipe from the kitchen of: Mom        Serves:
2 8oz cream cheese
(4oz) 3/4 c crumbled blue cheese
(4oz) 1 c shredded sharp, cheddar or bacon cheese spread
1/4 c. minced onion
1 Tbsp Worcestershire sauce
finely chopped parsley
Softn cheese. Add onion &
Woc. sauce. Beat w mixer
until fluffy. Chill.
